script_text: The cosmic winds are conspiring against your patience before Monday even begins, dear Aries. Tuesday brings Sun conjunct Venus into your 7th House, igniting romance, yet Mercury Retrograde flags a signed contract you must recheck. Wednesday’s New Moon in Libra seals the deal, making it the peak of your partnership energy this fortnight. Thursday brings Mercury conjunct Venus, intensifying your 7th House of passionate love. Friday stabilizes when Venus sextiles Jupiter, expanding your 3rd House networking and career opportunities you feared were truly dead. Saturday demands patience with your impulsive Fire nature before it costs you your peace. Friday is your power day because Jupiter lights your 3rd House with professional clarity this week. Wednesday is your worst day because retrograde Mercury confuses every verbal deal you sign today. Read every single contract clause aloud before you commit to anything new. Follow for daily updates.
